page.overview:
Who is Dorrah?

When mishears "voe" as "boe," corrects him, explaining that "voe" means "man" in the language. also explains that the word for "woman" is "vai". When finishes speaking to , she tells him that "Good-bye" is "sav'orq" in .

If tries to sneak into without being disguised or removes any piece of his disguise while inside, will yell that a man has been detected and commands the soldiers to capture him at once. is then thrown out to the front entrance of , where points her at him and tells him that men are forbidden by law.

Once obtains the , he can speak to again. She explains that is 's largest trade hub and that only "vai" are permitted to enter. When mishears "vai" as "bai," corrects him and explains that "vai" means "woman" in . She also explains that the word for "man" is "voe." recommends learning the language if plans to stay in .

After has been calmed, says that has calmed the and, if he is wearing the , can now relax in . She expects there to be more traffic in and out of , which means she will have to be more diligent to keep men from entering.
